q: Which indicators fell furthest since 2020? Show me.
a: Ranked bars, 2020 against today — and fair warning, those 2020 numbers are measured while today's are the page's illustrative starting scores, so this is the report's shape, not a surveyor's readout. Free political parties leads the plunge at 92 down to 86, six points out the window like a piano off a Winthrop fire escape; then freedom of expression 74 to 70, press 80 to 76, access to justice 78 to 74, judicial independence 80 to 76 — FOUR POINTS APIECE, A SYNCHRONIZED SWIM TEAM OF DECLINE. Effective parliament slips 62 to 60 and sits there at a fifty-year low, insolent, filing no paperwork. Six of the seven report-flagged declines are right here, and all but political parties are now the lowest since 1975 — three years after your Commencement. I'm watering the plastic fern. It's thriving.
